# AI usage log

The EE2026 manual requires AI usage to be clearly documented in the report.
Add an entry every time AI output goes into the project. Record what was generated,
and what a person changed by hand afterwards.

## 2026-10-05: Part B first build

**Tool:** Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, Anthropic), run locally.

**Input given to the AI:** the Part B build spec (`EE2026_PartB_order_engine_spec.md`) and the
team plan (`EE2026_trading_sim_plan.md`). Both documents were themselves written with AI help.

**Asked for:** "get started on the Part B code portion".

**Generated by the AI (every line of these files):**

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `src/shared/trading_defs.vh` | shared codes, copied from spec section 3 |
| `src/B_orders/ticket_layout.vh` | button and hit-region coordinates |
| `src/B_orders/spread_calc.v` | bid/ask from mid price |
| `src/B_orders/order_validate.v` | validation checks |
| `src/B_orders/order_book.v` | 8-slot book and trigger scan FSM |
| `src/B_orders/exec_engine.v` | arbiter FSM |
| `src/B_orders/order_entry.v` | ticket field state and input decoding |
| `src/B_orders/b_bin2bcd_seq.v` | sequential binary-to-BCD |
| `src/B_orders/ticket_screen.v` | Ticket page pixel logic |
| `src/B_orders/part_b_top.v` | wiring |
| `sim/stubs/stub_market.v`, `stub_ledger.v`, `stub_font.v` | stand-ins for A, C and D (font glyphs drawn by the AI) |
| `sim/B_orders/tb_*.v` (5 files) | self-checking testbenches |
| `sim/run_iverilog.sh`, `tools/hex2png.py` | test runner, frame dump converter |
| `README.md`, this file | documentation |

**Bugs the AI found by running its own testbenches, and fixed before hand-over:**

1. `exec_engine`: a submit arriving on the same clock as a book trigger was served second,
   against the spec's "submit has priority". Fixed by letting IDLE take a submit straight
   from the port. Caught by `tb_exec_engine` E7.
2. Testbench bugs (signed/unsigned arithmetic in `tb_part_b_top`, a wrong timing check in
   `tb_exec_engine`, delays inside functions in `tb_ticket_screen`). Testbench only, no RTL change.

**Design decisions the AI made that the spec did not settle:** listed in `README.md`
under "Decisions and deviations from the spec".

**Verification done:** Icarus Verilog 13.0 simulation (142 checks, all passing), a visual
check of the frame dumps, and a Yosys synthesis pass (no latches). Not yet run through
Vivado or on the board.

**Changed by hand afterwards:** nothing yet. Record each manual change below.
